programs.title: Blue Helmets, No Borders: Special Edition Ep.1
programs.desc: Centered on two UN peacekeeping missions in Lebanon and South Sudan, this series follows Chinese soldiers as they fulfill their peacekeeping commitments, embodying the message of a \"community with a shared vision for the future\" and highlighting the contemporary significance of global governance initiatives.

programs.title: Hermit Master Ep.1
programs.desc: This documentary tracks a three-year journey spanning tens of thousands of kilometers. Adopting a rational and scientific perspective, it interprets the origins of traditional Chinese martial arts and reveals the little-known inheritance and secrets of kung fu.

programs.title: The Grand Canal Ep.7
programs.desc: With the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal as longitude and its 3,000-year history as latitude, this series traces the canal's development from multiple angles, tells the life stories of those along its banks, and reveals the unique status of this world cultural heritage.

programs.title: Thrill Seeker's Guide to China – Mount Siguniang
programs.desc: Documents the journey of host He Tianran and National Geographic photographer Ma Chunlin through the Changping and Haizi valleys, culminating in their crowning achievement: the summit of Mount Siguniang in Sichuan Province.
